dialogs.text: Lutong, my dear Lutong, are you sure... this is the place?
Yes, Mr. Garcia, this is where Slimes are most often found.
I am most certain of that. However...
Would you agree that the Slimes are mildly overwhelming in quantity?
Mr. Garcia, this is how we end up when we are caught short financially.
You are... Garcia?
Traveler! What a coincidence!
What are you doing here?
Haha. Why, I'm here for...
Trouble.
Valiant adventure! Please, Lutong, could you not...
As you wish, sir.
In truth, I'm here to look for Slime Condensate to use as the lubricant for my Numbering Machine.
Unfortunately, most of the Slime Condensate on sale is of low quality as it's kept for too long. Besides...
Mr. Garcia purchased too many books...
Oh come now, those were... necessary expenditures — that left us short of Mora, yes, but still!
That's why we came here, to collect some fresh Slime Condensate ourselves.
But as you can see, though our good Lutong is from Liyue, he knows neither martial arts nor culinary skills.
Fortunately, I have a gift for accounting... all thanks to the complex tax rules of the Ministry of Civil Affairs.
...As for me, I can't possibly hit anyone with the components of my Numbering Machine.
Do you need my help?
Well, in a sense...
Yes.
Lutong, do we... um... do we have any Mora left?
Well, I believe we'll find a way to get by after we pay the Traveler.
Splendid. Traveler, I'd appreciate it if you could kindly retrieve some Slime Condensate for me.
What brings you here?
Once again, Mr. Garcia, I sincerely suggest that we sell a few books to raise some Mora.
No! Not for the world! Lutong, my dear, you are asking me to put my soul up for sale!
But sir, no one bids for souls.
Why are you still here?
Oh, Traveler? What brings you here?
Um... My last experiment failed. There was something wrong with my dilution of the Slime Condensate...
Instead of lubricating the bearings of the Numbering Machine, the lubricant actually made them more likely to get stuck.
As such, I need more Slime Condensate for further experiments. Could you...
Leave it to me.
Traveler, please help us collect the Slime Condensate. I'll have your payment ready.
Don't you have a way to earn Mora?
It's not that we don't...
It's a question of ability.
Thank you very much for this timely explanation, my dear Lutong.
Well, it's most certainly a shame... Although I have finished building the Numbering Machine, its functions are incalculably underwhelming.
It cannot even fully function as an automatic calculator, requiring manual aid to facilitate its operation.
But... I will enhance it! I firmly believe that my Numbering Machine will be a great invention!
An... An invention that heralds a new era! And after that, I'm sure I'll find a way to earn Mora...
H—However, before that...
Do you need some more Slime Condensate?
Sir, this might be the place we're looking for. Now we just have to return with some hires...
Sir? Mr. Garcia, are you listening to me?
Yeah? Oh... Of course, I'm listening. Let's go back and hire someone. It won't take long.
Is... is everything alright?
Traveler, ha... It's all right. I'm fine. Do I look I have a problem?
Now I am 100% committed to the research on the Numbering Machine, and I feel that I am only one step away from success.
If you're willing to help, would you please get some Slime Condensate for me?
Since you are here, I don't have to go back to the city to hire people. Now that I have made a little money now, I can offer you a better payment.
Sure.
I will leave this part to you, Traveler. As for me, I have to think about how to change the structure of the mechanism...
That sounds good to me...
Lutong, our Mora...
We'll get by, Mr. Garcia.
There is an old saying in Liyue, "When your path is blocked by a mountain, there will be a way through." I think this describes precisely where we are right now.
It means that when a mountain stands in our way, we will always find a way to get over it.
Aha! That's a clever metaphor. Then I suppose our situation is not quite so dire.
Still, Mr. Garcia, do you think the person who originally penned those words found a way across the mountain?
Eh? Come now, Lutong, don't jinx it...
Traveler, thanks for coming.
About Garcia...
You're right, it's Ms. Kaia. Though Mr. Garcia doesn't talk about it, he gets distracted more and more often at work.
And he never went to that café again. Now he just asks me to buy it for him.
Even Mr. Ahangar came to tell me that he could talk to Mr. Garcia if it's necessary.
I don't know how to straighten Mr. Garcia out, as I have no experience dealing with this kind of situation.
*sigh* Looks like there is another hurdle in front of me and Mr. Garcia...
He is still...
Traveler, have you obtained the Slime Condensate?
Got it right here.
Wonderful! This should suffice. I'll continue my experiments once I return. With this as the lubricant, my Numbering Machine will definitely...
I must attend to my research now. Lutong, please take care of the remaining affairs.
Yes, sir.
Here's your payment, Traveler. Thank you ever so much for your help.
And um... in my humble opinion, we might be in need of your help in the future.
Rest assured. As long as the accounts are in my hands, you will be paid fairly.
*sigh* ...Actually, I came to travel with Mr. Garcia because I didn't want to spend my whole life doing accounts in a department of the Ministry of Civil Affairs like my parents do.
But now... in addition to working with Mr. Garcia on his calculations, I also need to help him sort out his accounts...
I guess this is what they call destiny...
Traveler, have you obtained the Slime Condensate?
Got it right here.
Well, that's enough. Lutong, can you pay the Traveler first?
I need to check the quality of these Slime Condensate first...
Here's your payment, Traveler. Thank you for your help.
You are welcomed to swing by anytime.
If Mr. Garcia's mental state is too... unwell, maybe I'll need your help.
